scope: Seven original static designs for card folders.
styleReferenceUse: Inspected all three approved images before generation. Used them only for visual style and included their style in each full prompt. Did not copy subjects, brands, logos, or source pixels.
hardwareReferenceNote: The requested subjects are generic objects without real product markings.
generationPolicy: One separate initial image_gen call per design. VIDEOS also required one targeted image_gen correction after its first attempt failed review.

assets.name: ROMs
assets.subject: Generic game cartridge
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original static pixel-art folder icon for ZyperOS.
Style references: the inspected approved GB.png, PS1-ports.png, and FOLDER_SMALL.png images are style references only. Match their chunky square pixel clusters, dark blue-gray outline, warm upper-left highlights, cool lower-right shadows, and limited three-tone color ramps. Do not copy their subjects, brands, logos, or markings.
Style/medium: bold clean game pixel art built from a coarse grid of visibly square color clusters. Use flat three-tone shading for each color. Keep hard pixel steps, not smooth curves. Make one large recognizable object with few details, legible at 40 and 56 pixels.
Composition: square canvas, the complete object centered with generous transparent margins of at least 15% on every side. No crop.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background. No background color, scene, floor, shadow outside the object, glow, or checkerboard pattern.
Constraints: generic original object only. No brands, logos, label text, letters, numbers, product markings, watermark, photographs, tracing, or another icon set. No decorative secondary objects.
Subject: one generic game cartridge, shown almost from the front with a narrow right side. Use a warm light-gray shell, a single large blank muted-teal inset panel, two broad shoulder steps, and a short dark connector recess along the bottom. Give the shell a solid blocky silhouette. Keep the inset panel completely blank. Draw no screws, ribs, tiny contacts, or separate objects. This is a new object design; do not reproduce a real console's cartridge.
assets.motionChoice: Static source only. No moving parts and no screen.

checks: The stepped shoulder and bottom connector recess identify a game cartridge.
The blank teal inset is large and has no text or marking.
The dark outline, warm highlight, and cool right edge match the inspected references.
The source has no separate object, floor shadow, or background scene.

actualSizeReview.note: Reviewed the exported still at 256 pixels and browser-rendered previews at 56 and 40 pixels. The subject, outline, and main details remain clear. No visible glow, cropped shape, label text, or brand mark appears.
